name: primitives-texts-highlight
title: Highlight Text
description: A three-line headline where two phrases get coloured highlight blocks that sweep in from the left, one after the other, over a couple of seconds.
use: A hero headline should call out two key phrases as it scrolls into view.
avoid: The highlight colours are fixed in demo classes, and long highlighted phrases wrap awkwardly.
a11y: The sweep starts on view with no reduced-motion check, though the highlighted words stay readable because the text colour is set by you. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A centred three-line headline in white on black. Two phrases sit inside rounded colour blocks: indigo to violet behind the first, and sky blue to cyan behind the second.
behaves: Each highlight grows from zero to full width behind its phrase, left to right, with the second starting later. A Replay button clears both and runs the sweep again.
customise: Pass the phrase as text, and set delay, transition and in-view options; the highlight colour and rounding come from your own background classes.
weight: light: One span animating its background size; idle before it enters view.
